title: ES8.8 exact Enterprise10.6 maintenance pairing is missing from the curated route
problem: The current customer-managed compatibility matrix explicitly lists ES8.8.x on Enterprise10.6.1.1 and separates10.6.1.0. The curated ES8.8 Enterprise host mapping stops at10.4, and older10.6 descriptions are not reconciled to these exact maintenance rows. A line-level addition would still need the exact package and KV qualifications; it must not silently approve every10.6 build.
